## Story DD Coverage

## Description
Create tests/scratch/test-scratch-isolation.sh. Behavioral test: run ticket-init.sh in tmp dir, inspect .git/info/exclude resolved via `git rev-parse --git-path info/exclude`, assert exactly one `.scratch/` entry. Also assert that writing .tickets-tracker/.scratch/foo and running `git status --porcelain .tickets-tracker/` shows no untracked entries under .scratch/. Must FAIL before task-3.

- [ ] Lint passes

- [ ] Test FAILS pre-implementation (RED)
  Verify: bash tests/scratch/test-scratch-isolation.sh; [ $? -ne 0 ]
- [ ] Test asserts exactly-one .scratch entry
  Verify: grep -q scratch tests/scratch/test-scratch-isolation.sh && grep -qE 'grep -c|grep -cFx' tests/scratch/test-scratch-isolation.sh
